name: Holding On to Letting Go
source:
The protagonist,  a young woman who returns to her hometown after a tough breakup. Struggling to move forward, she gets caught up in the mysterious world of Vincent, a man surrounded by rumors of danger and secrets.

As the protagonist develops feelings for the mysterious Vincent, she discovers a complex web of hidden truths, betrayals, and unresolved past issues. 

Through unexpected twists and turns, the protagonist delves deeper into Vincent's world, facing dangerous situations that test her courage and love. 

In this thrilling Otome game, players experience a romantic drama filled with intrigue, danger, and the transformative power of love. 

[From [url=https://bigdeal.itch.io/holding-on-to-letting-go]Itch.io[/url]]
